papers.title: Wildfire Spread Forecasting With Deep Learning
papers.authors: Nikolaos Anastasiou, Spyros Kondylatos, Ioannis Papoutsis
papers.relevance: Primary foundation research paper behind the Orion-AI-Lab/WildFireSpread repository and the 27-variable Mesogeos NetCDF DataCube schema used in our project.
papers.project_component: Satellite Preprocessing, Multi-Spectral 27-Band Cubes, and 3D U-Net Spread Forecasting

papers.title: An Attention-Enhanced Bidirectional LSTM for Early Forest Fire Smoke Recognition
papers.authors: Yichao Cao, Feng Yang, Qingfei Tang, Xiaodong Lu
papers.relevance: Direct theoretical foundation for Hybrid Technique 2 (CNN + BiLSTM + Attention) to isolate slow-moving, low-salience early smoke plumes.
papers.project_component: Hybrid Model 2: CNN + BiLSTM + Attention Pipeline (models/convlstm_attention/)

papers.title: SmokeyNet: A Weakly Supervised Spatio-Temporal Approach for Early Wildfire Detection
papers.journal: IEEE / CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops (CVPRW, 2021)
papers.authors: Anshuman Dewangan, Yash Pote, Mai H. Nguyen, Frank Vernon, Ismael Perez, Ilkay Altintas
papers.relevance: Provides the spatio-temporal architecture uniting CNN/YOLO spatial tile representations, Vision Transformers (ViT), and LSTM sequence modeling using HPWREN camera feeds.
papers.project_component: Hybrid Model 1 (YOLO + EfficientNet + LSTM) & Hybrid Model 4 (YOLO + ViT + LSTM)

papers.title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows
papers.journal: IEEE / CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV, Best Paper Award, 2021)
papers.authors: Ze Liu, Yutong Lin, Yue Cao, Han Hu, Yixuan Wei, Zheng Zhang, Stephen Lin, Baining Guo
papers.relevance: Provides the hierarchical multi-scale shifted-window self-attention mechanism required to capture multi-scale smoke and flame boundaries alongside CNN feature fusion.

papers.title: Convolutional LSTM Neural Networks for Modeling Wildland Fire Dynamics
papers.journal: IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing / arXiv:2012.05979 (2020)
papers.authors: Thomas Burge, Matthew Bonanni, Christopher R. Meyer, et al.
papers.relevance: Demonstrates the mathematical formulation of ConvLSTM recurrent units to preserve spatial grid geometry across time-series satellite acquisitions for continuous perimeter expansion.
papers.project_component: Hybrid Model 5: ConvLSTM + Attention & Temporal Spread Estimation
